title: MAL/ISE/WCI/GCL Integration & Golden Learning/Recognition Proof

implementation_scope.purpose: Define deterministic read-only integration contracts that project explicit MAL, ISE, WCI and GCL owner-system references into ALP learning/recognition evidence and produce a canonical golden learning/recognition proof over the frozen ALP-01 through ALP-07 contracts without taking mutation authority from any owner system.
authorized: explicit MAL, ISE, WCI and GCL integration references with stable owner-system identity, source work-item identity, source object identity and provenance
deterministic mapping of explicitly authorized owner-system references into frozen ALP taxonomy families without manufacturing new owner-system state
golden learning-proof assembly from explicit authorized learning, practice, rehearsal or project-evidence references with satisfied, unsatisfied or unknown state preserved
golden recognition-proof assembly from explicit authorized achievement or recognition references with stable identity, subject, provenance and supplied order metadata preserved
explicit scenario identity and subject identity for the golden proof, requiring represented evidence from MAL, ISE, WCI and GCL rather than inferring absent systems
missing, hidden or unauthorized owner-system evidence remains unknown or omitted without hidden-cardinality inference
deterministic ordering and deterministic receipts independent of supplied integration-reference ordering
not_authorized: direct MAL, ISE, WCI or GCL mutation, command execution, content acquisition or owner-state creation
achievement awarding, completion mutation, recognition creation by implication or mechanical reward commit
automatic XP, advancement, capability, title or reputation grants
hidden or unauthorized evidence, event, recognition, owner-state or cardinality inference
notification sending, delivery, acknowledgement-state mutation or subscription mutation
universal permission or unrelated capability gates
GCL-13+ implementation, VTI-01+ implementation, provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment

next_action: Create the ALP-08 acceptance package on the registered application branch from exact baseline 773b9bcfbdc549e53e51dcedaae83b450a74c8fc, observe genuine matching Linux/Windows RED before production, then implement only the bounded read-only MAL/ISE/WCI/GCL integration and golden learning/recognition proof contract.
